n1.speaker: npc_crake
n1.text: The Compact. Signed. Glut's paw-print and Vael's perfect hand on the same page.

n2.speaker: npc_crake
n2.text: The Dominion keeps its debts honestly, Supervisor. This is not a debt. This is a sale of the dead.

n3.speaker: npc_crake
n3.text: Take it to the Provost. He will sign anything. Make him sign this. My Wardens will stand with you after.
